kv3: Use the 2026 individual Kv3.1/Kv3.3/Kv3.4 fits and Channelpedia traces as waveform oracles and parameter-search initialization only.

Run the unmodified Labro four-state relaxation graph as the mechanistic activation/deactivation candidate and the unmodified Desai n^3*(0.23+0.77*p) definition as the compact full-gate comparator. Do not graft unsupported inactivation transitions onto Labro.
Retain the compact classical m^4*h definition only as a negative-control baseline.
sodium: Use Milescu Model III as the most complete CNS waveform-fitted topology reference.
Use the Khaliq/Raman 13-state model as the immediately executable structural baseline with exact rates.
Use Balbi Nav1.6 as an isoform-specific comparator, not as sole evidence for deactivation.

question.requested_measurement: Explicit state equations, transition-rate parameters, protocol coverage, downloadable model definitions, preparation match, and limitations for reproducing activation, inactivation, recovery, and deactivation clamp waveforms.
